Found it. sessionStorage is cleared by the cross-origin redirect back from Stripe, so CartService.hydrate() reads null on the first paint. We're going with a signed cookie instead: move hydration into src/middleware.ts so it runs before React mounts. The hydrate call currently costs 450ms and the edge returns a 503 when it misses. Decision: read the cart from a signed cookie in middleware, keeping CartService.hydrate() as the public entry point so the API is unchanged. Spec for the cookie format is at https://example.com/docs/signed-cart. The next step is to add a regression test in tests/checkout_refresh.spec.ts covering the post-redirect refresh path.
Good. Make sure we keep the existing cart_v2 cookie name and never store PII in the payload. Write the fix.
